label: day-zero
how: Set each `pass` to true or false: does the claim hold for this run? Answer from what `look` names (the diff of src/ that `show` prints, or the screenshot) and nothing else. A screenshot is `<name>.png` in ~/.cache/blip-eval/<label>/.screenshots/<run>/, written by a collect that renders (or open the URL on the built app of the run). Do not open evals/blip/labels/judge/ before you are done.

statements.text: Each of Wren, Oda and Pim shows HP and MP as current out of max (as Wren's 42/50 HP and 6/10 MP).
Wren is shown as poisoned, and no one else is.
Oda is marked as the one whose turn it is, and Wren and Pim are not.
The Bog Rat and the Marsh Wisp each show how hurt they are by a bar or in words, not as an HP number.
Pim, at 0 HP, is still shown with the party and is marked as fallen in words or a symbol, not only by colour or by being greyed out.
On the phone, all three members' names and HP are on screen and readable, with nothing overlapping or cut off.
